'''Ackrahbala's Swoops & Speeders''' was a business operating in the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Bartyn's Landing]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]], as of [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]. It sold and rented [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]], [[subskimmer]]s, [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] and [[repulsorsail skiff]]s. For rents, it charged a deposit of a 10% of the official price of that kind of vehicle, in a state of used. The business was owned by the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Ackrahbala]].<ref name="Gamer" />
